config.cut_depth_rule: 0, then geometric ratio 1.5 from 1 below 128, then every 64

law.name: law C: integer nearest agreement with a fair tie coin
law.formula: attempt on seam (a, b) with loads x_a, x_b and coin c: t = x_a + x_b; x_a becomes ceil(t/2) if c = 1 else floor(t/2); x_b = t - x_a; current = old x_a - new x_a
law.schedule: per sweep seq = default_rng(seed).integers(0, S, size=S, dtype=int64), then coin = integers(0, 2, size=S, dtype=int64); attempt i acts on seam seq[i] with coin[i]

regime: quench: the seeded loads carry variance 35/12 per port against 1/4 in the balanced band; block totals are conserved, so after the balanced class is reached the long density modes are still far from the canonical equilibrium and relax at rate 2 lambda_k in scaled time tau = sweeps / (2 * 4^level); statistics of this run are quench statistics

layers.depth: causal depth of an attempt = 1 + max depth of the earlier attempts on its resources; resources are its two ports and, for a glue seam, its two screen plaquettes; depth_native uses ports only
layers.cuts: cut T = all attempts of depth <= T, a down-set of the causal order; the state on the cut is the state after exactly those attempts
layers.clocks: ticks[c] = attempts on the 33 seams incident to carrier c

register.rule: a repair with current j proposes delta = j mod 6 on its seam link; the faces that traverse the seam a->b and b->a change by +delta and -delta; it is applied when cost[new] - cost[old] <= kappa * j * (d - j), the mismatch potential 1/2 sum x^2 released by the repair in cost units

geometry.gluing_note: the routing reads port directions in a tangent frame built from the fixed axis (0,0,1), switching to (1,0,0) where |normal_z| > 0.9; the port graph therefore has no icosahedral rotation symmetry and the three slowest modes of the port Laplacian are split by about 3 percent (4^l lambda = 0.0408, 0.0416, 0.0419 at level 5). A property of the declared gluing, not of law C

observers.role: root observer (central cell of base face 0)
